svg.title: From the variable table to the wire, and the readings back again
svg.text: The master is a planner plus a scheduler, and neither invents anything.
the readings land back in the bank
Planning groups the site's XP_MODBUS rows into read and write blocks - one per contiguous run, on one unit, with one function code -
bounded by what the device table says that unit can actually answer. A unit nobody described plans against the protocol's own limits.
